title: {Syn} Happy Numbers Have a Surprisingly Grim Loop
content:
A happy number eventually reaches 1 when replaced repeatedly by the sum of the squares of its digits. For example, 19 goes to 82, then 68, 100, and finally 1.

Unhappy starting values fall into a cycle that includes 4. The joke is that the process has only one truly cheerful fixed ending.

Why it matters: math facts keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
